news.title: Westlake High teacher killed in Atlanta murder-suicide: Police
news.summary: Kelvin Smith, a 55-year-old engineering teacher at Westlake High School, was shot and killed by his younger brother in SW Atlanta.

news.title: Metro Atlanta police sergeant charged with DUI
news.summary: A South Fulton police officer faces traffic charges following an incident in Atlanta.

news.title: Mother and 4-year-old son killed in overnight house fire on Waters Road
news.summary: A woman and her 4-year-old son died after an overnight house fire on Waters Road in southwest Atlanta.

news.title: Teen screamed in ditch for hours after he was hit by alleged DUI driver

news.title: ‘A beautiful, gentle soul’: Pastor remembers man killed in road rage shooting
news.summary: A DeKalb County pastor is remembering a man he describes as a gentle, kind-hearted soul after he was killed in a deadly confrontation last month.

news.title: GBI charges 5 inmates in connection with death at DeKalb County Jail
news.summary: Authorities have charged Amir Andrews, Dajuhn Bryant, Treonte Brintley, Messiah Hinson, and Jayden King in the death of 24-year-old David Addo-Wright.

news.title: 5 inmates charged with murder following DeKalb jail death
news.summary: The Georgia Bureau of Investigation charged five inmates with murder and other felony offenses following the death of an inmate inside the DeKalb County Jail, authorities said Thursday.

news.title: Man hit, killed by bus in southwest Atlanta on Thursday morning
news.summary: A man was struck and killed by a FlixBus in southwest Atlanta on Thursday morning.

news.title: Man known for 'Florida Boy' tattoo convicted of trafficking and raping 15-year-old in metro Atlanta
news.summary: Christopher Clark, who was known for his "Florida Boy" tattoo in a sketch released by Georgia investigators in June 2022, was accused of raping a 15-year-old girl.

news.title: Tattoo helps crack case against metro Atlanta man trafficking 15-year-old
news.summary: A distinctive tattoo helped investigators identify a man accused of trafficking and raping a 15-year-old Clayton County girl.

news.title: Suspect death in Mexico prompts closure of Roswell murder case
news.summary: Roswell police have officially closed the investigation into the Christmas Eve 2024 murder of Blanca Sauer after confirming the suspect died by suicide in Mexico.

news.title: Riverdale man sentenced for rape, trafficking of teen girl
news.summary: A Riverdale man was sentenced to 20 years in prison after pleading guilty Wednesday to the rape, false imprisonment and trafficking of a 15-year-old girl in Clayton County, officials said.

news.title: Suspect in custody after shooting injures 2 teens in northwest Atlanta
news.summary: The incident occurred in the Joseph E. Boone Boulevard area near Kipp Ways Academy Charter School.
